Node ids have been added to the code as data attributes, e.g. data-node-id="1:2".
These styles are contained in the design: Left: Effect(type: DROP_SHADOW, color: #102D6114, offset: (60, 60), radius: 100, spread: 0), #2048E5: #2048E5.

These constants will be used in the code as the source for the image, ex: <img src={image} />.
